title: Power Electronics Simulation Program — Overview and definition
t: Power Electronics Simulation Program — Overview and definition
description: Simulates converters, inverters, and drives with switching devices and magnetics.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Simulates converters, inverters, and drives with switching devices and magnetics. A power electronics simulation program models buck, boost, flyback, bridge, and multilevel converters with realistic switch models, gate drives, magnetics saturation, and thermal coupling. Real implementations include PLECS, PSIM, LTspice, and Simscape Electrical. It computes efficiency maps, ripple, EMI spectra estimates, and control-loop stability.
capabilities: Piecewise-linear and detailed semiconductor device models
Magnetic component modeling with saturation and core loss
Closed-loop control design with averaged and switched models
Efficiency, loss-breakdown, and thermal estimation
Fault simulation: shoot-through, overvoltage, desaturation
